decisions: Separate customer-funded SBI VC Trade scheduled XRP purchases from card-point rewards and shareholder-benefit XRP credits.
Record the DCA mechanism as a customer-funded purchase product only when the customer selects XRP and prefunds JPY; do not infer active plans or executed units.
Record card points and shareholder XRP coupons as reward/distribution liabilities, not proof of public spot or OTC purchases.
Keep SBI Group's Ripple strategic-investor/JV relationship distinct from actual XRP treasury holdings or purchases.
Do not conflate Tokyo SBIC East Japan with SBI Holdings or SBI VC Trade.
Keep Binance and Liqwall price/derivatives series provider-scoped; do not average open-interest totals or confuse rolling and UTC-day liquidation windows.
Keep all new market features out of the directional prediction engine pending provenance, point-in-time history and out-of-sample validation.
PR #1419 and #1420 are bounded fresh-main draft remediations; they remain unmerged and main writers remain active.
required_verification: Obtain XRP-specific SBI DCA plan counts, monthly JPY order/fill totals and external execution/inventory reconciliation.
Obtain SBI VISA card XRP selection mix, monthly points and XRP units credited.
Obtain each SBI shareholder program's eligible-holder count, redemption rate and XRP units credited.
Reconcile reward liabilities with SBI VC Trade treasury inventory and external spot/OTC purchases.
Complete exact-head validation of the new research-ledger append.
Obtain fresh-main workflow remediation review; do not merge without user approval.
Resolve remaining main-branch writer paths, branch protection evidence, dependency lockfiles and security-alert access.
